violations.why: irq_husk (higher priority) can preempt irq_urchin between v_wharf++ and the read-back, overwriting v_wharf with 1.
irq_husk can write v_wharf between urchin's read and its write of 0.
v_lagoon++ is a non-atomic read-modify-write, and irq_husk can preempt it and set v_lagoon=1, so the update is lost.
irq_husk can reset v_inlet to 1 between the index use at line 52 and the increment at line 53.
irq_husk's write of v_inlet=1 can land between urchin's index read and its increment write, so the increment overwrites it.
